notes.title: Fallen Seeds II Announced – The Story Continues!
notes.content:
Dear friends!

We are excited to announce that the second part of our sci-fi visual novel, Fallen Seeds, is now in development! [url=store.steampowered.com/app/3109240/Fallen_Seeds_II/]Fallen Seeds II[/url] continues the journey of Earth Empire’s special agent Evod and his charming companions. This time, their adventures on the mysterious planet Ulthar will reach a thrilling climax.

[previewyoutube=Gbhie4Mueks;full][/previewyoutube]

Expect more political intrigue, hidden dangers, and unexpected twists. Explore the world of Fallen Seeds, where every decision you make will shape the unfolding events and the fate of the characters. We’ve worked hard to keep everything you loved from the first part while adding new exciting elements to make your experience even more immersive.

Thank you for your support! [url=store.steampowered.com/app/3109240/Fallen_Seeds_II/]Whishlist now[/url] and stay tuned for more updates – there’s much more to come.

notes.title: Fallen Seeds Artbook Extra – Third and Final DLC Supporter Pack!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667993/9f0c2382c5a7490dfc060f16ed1950322157553f.jpg[/img]

Dear friends,

We are excited to announce the release of the third and final DLC Supporter Pack – [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3033690/Fallen_Seeds_Artbook_Extra/]Fallen Seeds Artbook Extra[/url]! This artbook offers a unique insight into the game's universe, featuring early concepts in a different style, characters not included in the first part of the game, fan art, promo art, and special illustrations created specifically for this collection.

Like the main artbook, the Fallen Seeds Artbook Extra is available in PDF format and includes a set of UHD PNG images that can be used as desktop wallpapers.

By purchasing this artbook, you not only get a behind-the-scenes look at the game’s creation but also support the developers, helping us continue working on the second part of Fallen Seeds.

Key Features:

[list]
[*] Early concepts in a different style
[*] Characters not included in the first part of the game
[*] Fan art and promo art
[*] Special illustrations created for the artbook
[*] A set of PNG images for use as desktop wallpapers
[*] All illustrations created by the project artist Alice Makoveeva
[/list]
Thank you for your support and enjoy the artwork!

notes.title: Fallen Seeds releases 1 p.m. GMT today!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667993/af29a781fa16a39b4149ccf542a490f0fcabdf3d.png[/img]

Dear Friends,

The game release is just around the corner! Here are some final pre-release notes from us:

If you installed the early demo, we recommend deleting the demo save files from your user folder for a better experience. This can prevent conflicts with new save files, which might cause the game to halt when loading saves. Typically, the save files are located in: 
C:\Users\<your_user>\AppData\Local\FallenSeeds.

We hope you have a fantastic experience with Fallen Seeds! Have fun and please share your feedback with us!

notes.title: Fallen Seeds Releases on May 8th!
notes.content:
Dear friends, we are delighted to announce that our game Fallen Seeds will be released on May 8th.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667993/62ebd01086875db6fe709badf9b6276b71ea6941.png[/img]

The game is intended for audiences over the age of 16. Erotic content is present but is succinctly integrated into the narrative, which is the main focus of the first installment of our planned trilogy.

Here are more details about the game:
Fallen Seeds offers 6 routes. The total text volume reaches 55 thousand words, and a full playthrough, according to our estimates, will take about 10 hours. The game includes more than 10 endings, the exact number of which we prefer to keep secret.
Additionally, you can expect:
[list]
[*] 23 characters,
[*] more than 80 background locations,
[*] 23 original music compositions,
[*] partial voice acting for all characters.
[/list]

notes.title: Fallen Seeds — Announcement Trailer Now on YouTube!
notes.content:
Greetings, Explorers of Ulthar!

We are thrilled to unveil the Announcement Trailer, which has just premiered on YouTube! Prepare to embark on an interstellar journey filled with intrigue, romance, and mystery.

[previewyoutube=5oz_TzUWqqA;full][/previewyoutube]

🚀 What’s in the Trailer?
Dive into the rich, animated world of our game and get your first look at the incredible adventure that awaits. Meet Evod, our brave protagonist, and get a glimpse of the potential romantic paths with the enigmatic inhabitants of Ulthar.

🌐 Vivid World, Compelling Characters
Discover the vibrant environments and frame-by-frame 2D animations that bring the world of Ulthar to life. From the bustling alien streets to the enigmatic Anomalous Zone, each scene is crafted with love and attention to detail.

💖 Forge Your Path
The choices you make will shape Evod’s journey and the relationships he builds with the Chimy race. Who will you get close to? The fierce warrior Kaya? The wise scientist Sif? Or perhaps the other intriguing characters you'll meet along the way?

👀 See It for Yourself
Don't miss out on the visual feast and the teases of the mystical riddles waiting to be unraveled. Head over to YouTube and witness the beginning of an epic tale.

✨ Join the Community
After watching, join us back here in the Steam community hub to discuss your thoughts and expectations. We can't wait to hear what you think!

The stars are the limit, and your journey is just beginning. Watch the trailer now and prepare for your mission on Ulthar!

Stay stellar,
KPD Team.

notes.content:

We are thrilled to announce that the highly-anticipated demo version of "Fallen Seeds" is now available for download right here on Steam!

Dive into the vibrant world of Ulthar and get a taste of the captivating universe we've crafted for you. Meet our protagonist, Evod, interact with the enigmatic Chimy race, and unravel the first threads of the story that awaits.

Whether you're a fan of science fiction or a visual novel enthusiast, "Fallen Seeds" promises an engaging blend of intrigue, romance, and adventure.

Feedback Wanted!
Your thoughts and feedback are invaluable to us. After playing the demo, we'd love to hear about your experiences, suggestions, or any bugs you might encounter.

Ready to embark on a stellar adventure? [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2620940/Fallen_Seeds/]Download the demo[/url] now and let the journey begin!

Stay tuned for more updates and news about the full release.

Warm regards,
KPD Team
